@@ -1192,118 +1189,0 @@
-// predicates controlling emit of fence before and after CAS
-
-// Return true if the trailing MemBarAcquire around a CAS-like LoadStore node
-// may be elided, that is if the node is matched to a single AMO instruction
-// carrying both the aq and rl annotations: amoswap/amoadd/amocas with .aqrl.
-// The leading MemBarRelease has a weaker condition of its own, see
-// cas_leading_membar_elidable() below.
-//
-// Such an AMO is fully-ordered under RVWMO: PPO rule 5 orders it, including
-// its store, before every subsequent memory access, and PPO rule 6 orders
-// every preceding access before it. That subsumes both membars.
-//
-// An LR/SC based CAS has different ordering properties from a single AMO.
-// The aq annotation on LR orders its load before later accesses (PPO rule 5),
-// while the rl annotation on SC orders earlier accesses before its successful
-// store (PPO rule 6). These annotations must not be treated as .aqrl on a
-// single instruction: for an AMO the acquire annotation covers the store
-// event too, so PPO rule 5 also orders the AMO's store before subsequent
-// loads. An SC's store carries only a release annotation, so the only rule
-// that could order it before a subsequent load is PPO rule 7, which requires
-// both accesses to carry RCsc annotations. A subsequent volatile load never
-// qualifies: without Zalasr it is a plain load followed by fence r,rw, and
-// with Zalasr it is an RCpc acquire load, neither of which is RCsc.
-//
-// Keep the trailing MemBarAcquire for the existing LR/SC mapping rather than
-// extending the single-AMO elision to LR/SC.
-bool cas_trailing_membar_elidable(int opcode)
-{
-  assert(is_CAS(opcode, true), "expecting a compare and swap");
-
-  switch (opcode) {
-    // Always matched to the acquiring variant, hence amoswap/amoadd.aqrl.
-    case Op_GetAndSetI:
-    case Op_GetAndSetL:
-    case Op_GetAndSetP:
-    case Op_GetAndSetN:
-    case Op_GetAndAddI:
-    case Op_GetAndAddL:
-      return true;
-    // Matched to amocas.{w|d}.aqrl only when Zacas is available.
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapI:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapL:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapP:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapN:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeI:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeL:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeP:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeN:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapI:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapL:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapP:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapN:
-      return UseZacas;
-    // Matched to amocas.{b|h}.aqrl only when Zacas and Zabha is available.
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapB:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapS:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeB:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeS:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapB:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapS:
-      return UseZacas && UseZabha;
-    default:
-      return false;
-  }
-}
-
-// Return true if the leading MemBarRelease around a CAS-like LoadStore node may
-// be elided. The required release ordering places accesses preceding the CAS
-// before its successful store, and the rl annotation on that store provides
-// this ordering by PPO rule 6. This is the same release property relied on by
-// the is_Store() branch of unnecessary_release() for a releasing store.
-// An LR/SC pair therefore qualifies here, whereas cas_trailing_membar_elidable()
-// above restricts elision to a single AMO carrying both aq and rl annotations.
-bool cas_leading_membar_elidable(int opcode)
-{
-  assert(is_CAS(opcode, true), "expecting a compare and swap");
-
-  switch (opcode) {
-    // Matched to amoswap/amoadd.aqrl.
-    case Op_GetAndSetI:
-    case Op_GetAndSetL:
-    case Op_GetAndSetP:
-    case Op_GetAndSetN:
-    case Op_GetAndAddI:
-    case Op_GetAndAddL:
-      return true;
-    // Matched to amocas.{w|d}.aqrl with Zacas, to lr.{w|d}.aq + sc.{w|d}.rl
-    // without it. Both carry the rl annotation on their successful store.
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapI:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapL:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapP:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapN:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeI:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeL:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeP:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeN:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapI:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapL:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapP:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapN:
-      return true;
-    // Sub-word forms reach amocas.{b|h}.aqrl with Zacas and Zabha. Otherwise
-    // they are open coded around lr.w/sc.w or amocas.w, with rl still set on
-    // the successful store. The Zacas expansion uses lw_acquire for its
-    // acquiring pre-check; early failure publishes no store, so it does not
-    // require a leading release fence either.
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapB:
-    case Op_CompareAndSwapS:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeB:
-    case Op_CompareAndExchangeS:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapB:
-    case Op_WeakCompareAndSwapS:
-      return true;
-    default:
-      return false;
-  }
-}
-
